frames.name: sg_b
frames.prompt: Evening in a warm, lived-in suburban living room. A married couple in their early 40s sits close together on a worn brown leather couch, medium two-shot from the knees up, facing the camera at a slight angle. HIM (Danny), on the left: white American man, 42, stocky, short dark-brown hair greying at the temples, short full beard, warm brown eyes, laugh lines, faded navy flannel shirt over a grey t-shirt. HER, on the right: Black American woman, 40, natural shoulder-length curly hair, small gold hoop earrings, cozy mustard-yellow cardigan over a white tee. She holds her phone between them, playing a song for him (screen not visible). He grins mischievously, mouth slightly open, one eyebrow raised, clearly about to crack a joke; she looks at him warmly. Table lamp glow, knitted throw blanket, blurred framed photos on the wall behind (no readable faces).

frames.name: sg_g

frames.name: sg_a

Ignore the couch, Danny and the living room of the reference; only keep her identity and the warm color grade.

frames.name: sg_c
frames.prompt: NEW SHOT, flashback, same man (Danny: identical face, beard, hair): a dark, freezing January night, heavy snow falling on a quiet suburban street lit by one streetlamp and a car's amber headlights. Danny, in a dark green parka and a knit beanie with snow on his shoulders, digs out a snowed-in small silver sedan with a snow shovel, breath steaming, determined. Medium-wide shot, he fills the center third, upper body clearly visible. Cool blue-teal night tones with warm amber headlight glow. Ignore the couch, the woman and the living room of the reference; only keep Danny's identity.

frames.name: sg_d
frames.prompt: NEW SHOT, flashback, the same couple the same January night: inside their front hallway, the front door open behind him onto a cold blue snowy night. Danny has just come back inside, snow on his dark green parka, beanie and beard, shrugging with a modest lopsided grin and holding out a set of car keys to her. She stands in the hallway in flannel pajamas and a robe, one hand on her chest, moved. Warm hallway light. Medium two-shot from the side, both faces visible.
